mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cs_capability_idempotency ( storage_key_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL, request_fingerprint_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, owner_token VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, lease_until BIGINT NOT NULL, result_json LONGTEXT NULL, result_schema_version INT NULL, created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (storage_key_hash), INDEX idx_cs_capability_idempotency_updated_at (updated_at) )
mapper.select: SELECT request_fingerprint_hash, status, owner_token, lease_until, result_json, COALESCE(result_schema_version, 0) AS result_schema_version FROM cs_capability_idempotency WHERE storage_key_hash = #{keyHash}
